C: open the Compendium.
P: open the Passive Skill Tree.
O: open the World Tree.
G: cycle disabled toggleable enchantments on the held tool.
W/S while riding: move forward or backward.
A/D on a Horse: steer with gradual, speed-sensitive turning while the camera looks freely.
Sprint + Forward: Horse Gallop, Donkey/Mule Pack Trot, or Strider Lava Rush.
Jump on a Horse: immediately perform its full jump; Camels retain their dash control.
Inventory key while riding a Pig, Strider, or Camel: open its shared mount inventory.
Sneak + empty-hand Use on a Pig, Strider, or Camel: open its shared mount inventory. Vanilla-inventory mounts keep their normal horse inventory controls.
Mouse wheel: zoom a tree, scroll guide pages, horse panels, and the inventory stats list.
Left-drag: pan around a tree.
All key assignments can be changed in Minecraft Controls. If another mod uses the same key, rebind one of them.

The inventory stats panel shows calculated player totals. Scroll it when the list is longer than the panel.
Entity overhead bars can show health, Energy Shield, ailments, armour, and evasion according to client settings.
Damage numbers are colour-coded by physical, fire, cold, lightning, void, drowning, and healing.
The party HUD tracks connected party members.
The mount resource bar shows Horse Stamina, Donkey/Mule/Camel Endurance, or Strider Heat and can be repositioned in the Mod Menu HUD layout editor.
Mod Menu exposes HUD visibility, scale, placement, entity-bar behaviour, and related client presentation options. These settings do not change server-side combat values.
